source.title: Data Highlight on Diabetes Disparities in Medicare Fee-For-Service
source.location: Opening summary: Medicare FFS diabetes prevalence remained relatively steady from 2012–2018 (32.2% to 27.7%)
source.citation: CMS Office of Minority Health. Data Highlight on Diabetes Disparities in Medicare FFS (2021).

population.enrollment_notes: Source cites Medicare FFS population prevalence; MVP approximates with Option B full-year A+B and HMO months = 0.

cohort.inclusion_notes: National FFS diabetes prevalence cited for 2018 endpoint of 2012–2018 series.

result.notes: Published 27.7% for 2018 Medicare FFS diabetes prevalence.

assumptions: Year transport from 2018 evidence to 2021 MVP context.
MBSF sp_diabetes approximates the source CCW/MMD diabetes definition.

governance.rationale: Accepted as calibration target #1 (diabetes prevalence) for mvp corpus v1. Not a Medicare finding when compared on synthetic tables.
